verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS is a live and real-time streaming service with stages and audio rooms. Telephony bridging via SIP is a fair axis for real-time communication platforms of this kind. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions SIP, trunking, or interoperability with telephony carriers; the docs cover only RTMP ingest, WebRTC-style stages, SDKs, chat and EventBridge.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the service documents SIP interoperability with my existing trunking or telephony provider rather than locking me to one carrier
